# Game Catalog

A selected Unbound Cloud game defines which species, moves, items, and balls exist and supplies most names and species data. CFRU supplies compiled move details and item kinds; DPE supplies learnsets, battle forms, and local sprites. The catalog carries diagnostics and image URLs rather than writing to any reference repository.

## Files

- [repositories.js](../../../server/services/repositories.js): `readCloudGames` discovers Cloud's declared games and form icon names from `src/PokemonUtil.jsx`, filters games without required files, and orders official games first, then by display name.
- [workspaces.js](../../../server/endpoints/workspaces.js): `POST /api/workspaces/load` supplies the game menu; `POST /api/workspaces/:id/catalog` calls `loadGameCatalog` for a selected `gameId`.
- [catalog.js](../../../server/services/catalog.js): `createCatalogService`, `loadGameCatalog`, `readGameData`; joins Cloud JSON, CFRU tables, DPE data, sprites, and unresolved-symbol warnings into one per-game response.
- [data-parser.js](../../../server/services/data-parser.js): `parseBattleMoves`, `parseItemTypes`, `parseLevelUpLearnsets`, `parseEggMoves`, `parseTeachableTables`, `parseCompatibilityFile`, `parseEvolutionTable`, `parseSpriteTable` read active C data and compatibility text without evaluating C expressions.
- [learnsets.js](../../../server/services/learnsets.js): `parseDpeSources`, `loadDpeData`, `buildLearnsets`, `buildBattleForms` load DPE move sources, inherit moves, and identify Mega Evolution/Gigantamax forms.
- [sprites.js](../../../server/services/sprites.js): `parseSpriteSources`, `loadSpriteTables`, `getDpeSpriteUrls`, `renderSprite`, `combineSpritePalette` map DPE species to graphics and render normal/shiny indexed PNGs.
- [assets.js](../../../server/services/assets.js): `readCloudImages`, `resolveCloudImage`, `getSpeciesIcon`, `getSpeciesSprites`, `getItemIcon`, `getBallIcon`, `getTypeIcon`, `getTypeSymbol`, `getGigantamaxIcon` select available local and remote artwork.
- [pokeapi.js](../../../server/services/pokeapi.js): `createPokeApiIndex` caches PokeAPI Pokemon and type name-to-ID lists for form-accurate sprite URLs.
- [images.js](../../../server/endpoints/images.js): token-free, workspace-scoped Cloud PNG and DPE sprite routes with same-site resource policy and image cache headers.
- [parse-cache.js](../../../server/services/parse-cache.js): `createParseCache`, `getParserVersion`, `hash`, `hashMacros` invalidate parsed CFRU/DPE data when sources, macros, or parser implementation change.
- [catalog.mjs](../../../shared/catalog.mjs): `LEARN_SOURCES`, `LEARNSET_COMPLETE`, `LEGALITY`, `getMoveLegality`, `POWER_KIND`, `getPowerKind`, `alwaysHits`, `getMegaEvolutions` are pure shared interpretations.
- [CatalogDisplay.jsx](../../../src/subcomponents/CatalogDisplay.jsx): `getLabel`, `getEntry`, `getSpeciesFormName`, `TypeIcon`, `SplitIcon`, `GameImage`, `OverflowText`, `getSearchRank`, `filterBySearch`, `useIncrementalList`, and `scrollToEntry` display and search catalog data.
- [Header.jsx](../../../src/components/Header.jsx): `Load Warnings` groups source diagnostics into expandable lists. [SpreadEditorState.jsx](../../../src/SpreadEditorState.jsx): game selection, catalog loading, and changed-move existence checks before save.

## Data flow

1. Workspace load parses Cloud's game configuration as source, rather than executing it. It keeps declared games with the required `baseStats`, `moves`, `items`, and `ballTypes` JSON files, returns menu IDs/names, and warns about unavailable games. The browser restores a saved game only when still listed; selecting a game posts its ID to the catalog route.
2. `loadGameCatalog` rejects unknown game IDs with `GAME_NOT_FOUND`, parses every required game JSON object, and reads optional shared Cloud name, dex, move, type, ability, shiny, and image data. Missing shared files use empty maps with warnings; malformed JSON or non-object required data yields `CATALOG_INVALID`.
3. In parallel it loads CFRU's preprocessed `gBattleMoves`, DPE's move/evolution tables, the PokeAPI index, Cloud image listings, and DPE sprite tables. CFRU `gItemsByType` is parsed separately using the same compiled config macros; missing item tables leave `itemType: null` and a warning.
4. The service builds species and moves first, then items, balls, types, and game-specific learnsets and battle forms. It counts complete learnsets, counts unresolved constants used by loaded spreads, attaches all diagnostics, and returns `gameId`, `name`, `entryCounts`, `species`, `learnsets`, `moves`, `items`, `balls`, `abilities`, `natures`, `types`, `assets`, `unresolved`, and `diagnostics`.
5. Browser helpers render names and icons, choose move legality and power displays, and show `Load Warnings`. Local image URLs go through `/api/images/:workspaceId/...`; remote URLs go directly to PokeAPI/PokeSprite and are resolved by `GameImage` at display time.

## Behavior and user decisions

- Cloud's game menu comes from `GAME_DISPLAY_NAMES` and `GAME_IDS_TO_DATA` in `PokemonUtil.jsx`. Only declared games with resolvable existing required files are selectable. The `cfru` official game precedes the remaining games sorted by name. `SPECIES_FORMS_ICON_NAMES` supplies icon aliases. A missing saved choice sends the browser to `Choose Game` rather than silently selecting another game.
- Available Cloud `BaseStats.json` species exclude `SPECIES_NONE`. Each entry has `name`, `showdownName` from alternate names when available, `dex`, numeric `dexNumber`, base stats (`hp`, `atk`, `def`, `spAtk`, `spDef`, `spd`), two types, three abilities ordered hidden/slot 1/slot 2, icon, normal/shiny sprite info, `megas`, and `gigantamax`. Missing/malformed stats, types, or abilities stay `null` and generate `CATALOG_SPECIES_INCOMPLETE` with every affected species in `details`. Missing shared names fall back to readable constants.
- Available Cloud moves exclude `MOVE_NONE`; Cloud supplies names and fallback type/split/PP, while compiled CFRU `gBattleMoves` supplies power, `zMovePower`, `maxMovePower`, accuracy, priority, target, effect, secondary chance, flags, and preferred type/split/PP. An absent CFRU move has `local: false` with unknown details and `MOVE_DETAILS_MISSING`. CFRU/Cloud differences in type, split, or PP use CFRU and yield `MOVE_DATA_MISMATCH` with every difference in `details`.
- `parseBattleMoves` reads literal numeric/symbol/flag fields from the active branch; unreadable values remain `null`. `z_move_power` maps to `zMovePower`; `gDynamaxMovePowers` supplies `maxMovePower`, which is `null` if that table is not compiled and zero when the table exists but omits a move. `getPowerKind` returns unknown for null, none for zero, variable for one, otherwise fixed; `alwaysHits` means CFRU accuracy zero.
- Items use Cloud names and either PokeSprite's Cloud `link` or an existing local Cloud image; `ITEM_NONE` has no icon. `itemType` comes from CFRU `gItemsByType`, with unknown kinds left null. Balls use Cloud names and PokeSprite ball images; `BALL_TYPE_RANDOM` is always named `Random` with no icon. Natures and abilities use Cloud shared name maps. Types have a `symbol` PokeSprite icon and a full `icon` banner from PokeAPI when indexed, otherwise PokeSprite. `assets.gigantamax` is a Cloud image when present.
- `loadDpeData` uses DPE config and active `Learnsets.c`, `Egg_Moves.c`, `TM_Tutor_Tables.c`, `Evolution Table.c`, and numbered TM/tutor compatibility files. Level zero is an evolution move; compatibility file number selects the table move even when the heading disagrees. Missing or uncompiled level-up tables leave status `missing` and legality unknown, even if other sources supply moves. Available source labels have fixed `LEARN_SOURCE_ORDER`.
- `buildLearnsets` combines level, egg, TM, tutor, special breeding/tutor, pre-evolution, shared-form, form-change, and Sketch sources. Permanent evolution and selected form links inherit until no new moves appear; Mega and Gigantamax evolutions do not inherit as permanent forms. Sketch adds game moves except Struggle, Chatter, and Sketch itself. CFRU's `EXPANDED_MOVE_TUTORS` and conditional `UNBOUND` macros decide special tutor availability; otherwise applicable moves can be marked `unknown` with a reason. Form-specific replacement moves are added after inheritance. `LEARNSET_MISSING` lists all affected game species when a level-up table exists.
- Cosplay Pikachu signatures are added by `COSPLAY_FORM_CHANGE_MOVES` after inheritance with source `formChange`, so ordinary Pikachu and other costumes do not inherit them: Libre gets `MOVE_FLYINGPRESS`, Rock Star `MOVE_METEORMASH`, Belle `MOVE_ICICLECRASH`, and Pop Star `MOVE_DRAININGKISS`. DPE assigns these forms the ordinary Pikachu level-up table; CFRU's `gPikachuSpreads` confirms these four signatures. PhD gets `MOVE_FLAMETHROWER` only when the evaluated CFRU config defines `UNBOUND`, not from a Cloud game name. This small fallback table covers grants not represented by DPE learnsets; the checkout has no dedicated cosplay teaching routine. Only moves available in the selected game are added, and missing DPE learnsets still mean unknown legality. Shared `getMoveLegality`, both move pickers, and Auto-Fix consume the resulting learnsets without separate species exceptions. Changes to this table invalidate parsed caches through the existing hash of the learnsets module; no cache format bump is needed.
- `buildBattleForms` reads DPE `EVO_MEGA` entries triggered by held `ITEM_*` or `MOVE_*`, including the variant, and enabled `EVO_GIGANTAMAX` entries. Each form records whether its target species is in the selected game; missing targets yield `BATTLE_FORM_UNAVAILABLE`. `getMegaEvolutions` returns only a species' item- or move-triggered matches, not every possible form.
- `getMoveLegality` returns `none` for 0/`MOVE_NONE`, `undefined` if the selected game lacks the move, `unknown` without a complete species learnset or when `learnset.unknown` gives a conditional reason, `allowed` with learn sources when present, and `illegal` otherwise. Browser save validation blocks newly selected undefined moves, not every move marked illegal or unknown.
- `loadSpriteTables` matches DPE front tiles, normal palette, and optional shiny back palette through its tables and graphics listings. DPE sprites take priority when found, with other artwork retained as fallbacks. `combineSpritePalette` uses indexed PNG IHDR and IDAT from front tiles, swaps in normal or shiny PLTE, emits `tRNS` making palette index zero transparent, and writes PNG chunk CRCs. A missing shiny palette falls back to the other shiny URL. Unmatched species use Cloud custom image, exact PokeAPI form, Cloud gen 9 image, PokeSprite form icon with base PokeAPI fallback, or null according to availability. Custom Unbound shiny colors apply only to game IDs matching `unbound` or `unbound_*`.
- Cloud image links are emitted only for filenames found in allowlisted image folders: `root`, `items`, `gen9`, `gen9Shiny`, `unboundShinies`. `resolveCloudImage` accepts only a simple `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+.png` in one folder and rejects traversal or unknown folders; owned-file resolution forbids links outside Cloud. The sprite endpoint accepts only `normal`/`shiny` and a `SPECIES_[A-Z0-9_]+.png` found in loaded DPE tables, and reads only owned DPE files. Both routes send PNGs with private one-hour caching, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-site`, and `nosniff`. Images cannot send a session token, so the image routes rely on these restrictions and local-host security.
- PokeAPI index is downloaded as name-to-ID lists, cached outside repositories for 30 days, deduplicated across concurrent loads, and refresh failures keep an older index. Without one, sprites may use dex numbers or icons and emit `SPRITES_OFFLINE`; lack of PokeAPI never blocks catalog loading. Parsed CFRU moves/item types use source hash plus macros and parser version; DPE tables/sprite tables hash their sources and parser version. Rendered DPE PNGs are cached per workspace/table version with a bounded map.
- Every aggregated diagnostic with a `details` list retains all affected entries, even though its message shows only a few examples. Not every single-file diagnostic has `details`; do not truncate an existing list when changing diagnostics. `UNRESOLVED_SYMBOL` records every unknown species, move, item, ball, or nature constant with spread counts and does not guess replacements. The `Load Warnings` dialog groups by repository, source file when `details` exist, and diagnostic code; expanded groups show every detail as a list item or the message when there are no details. Its heading count is the number of lines, not the number of diagnostic objects.
- `getLabel` returns the string or object's `name`, falling back to the constant; `getEntry` returns null for absent/non-string keys. `getSpeciesFormName` adds the alternate showdown suffix only when it starts with the plain species name plus `-`. `TypeIcon` defaults to the symbol only, with `full` selecting the banner; `SplitIcon` uses the physical/special/status icon and tooltip. `GameImage` keeps explicit dimensions, resolves server URLs, tries successive sources on error, and shows a placeholder if none load. `OverflowText` opens a tooltip only when text actually overflows. Search trims and ignores case, ranks prefix matches before substring matches while keeping order within each rank. `useIncrementalList` starts at 100, loads 100 more near the scroll bottom, and resets on `resetKey` changes.

## Invariants and pitfalls

- Catalog availability is per selected game. Do not substitute a similarly named Cloud constant, use a different game's stats, or treat unknown DPE legality as proven illegal.
- Do not make PokeAPI or optional Cloud image failures fatal. Keep sprite fallbacks and null details honest; CFRU values take precedence over disagreeing Cloud move details.
- Parse only compiler-active C branches and invalidate cache entries when configuration macros, sources, or parser code change. Keep [catalog.mjs](../../../shared/catalog.mjs) free of browser and Node APIs.
- Keep image routing constrained to the selected workspace and allowlisted owned files. Preserve complete diagnostic detail arrays for warning grouping.

## Tests

- [catalog.test.js](../../../server/tests/services/catalog.test.js): compiled move/item/DPE tables, learnset inheritance, conditional legality, battle forms, artwork selection, indexed shiny PNGs, PokeAPI cache/offline behavior, and shared lookups. Run: `cd server; yarn test tests/services/catalog.test.js`.
- [workspaces.test.js](../../../server/tests/endpoints/workspaces.test.js): Cloud game list/order, per-game payload/diagnostics, fallback/offline cases, image route allowlist and PNGs, catalog cache, invalid games and JSON. Run: `cd server; yarn test tests/endpoints/workspaces.test.js`.
- [parse-cache.test.js](../../../server/tests/services/parse-cache.test.js): per-input cache invalidation and unreadable-cache fallback. Run: `cd server; yarn test tests/services/parse-cache.test.js`.
- [RepositorySetup.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/RepositorySetup.test.jsx): game selection and `Load Warnings` grouping/detail expansion. Run: `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/RepositorySetup.test.jsx --run`.
- [MovePicker.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/MovePicker.test.jsx), [ItemPicker.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/ItemPicker.test.jsx), and [SpreadEditor.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadEditor.test.jsx): legality, picker names/icons/search/pagination, type symbol versus full banner, and selected-game presentation. Run: `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/MovePicker.test.jsx --run`, `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/ItemPicker.test.jsx --run`, and `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/SpreadEditor.test.jsx --run`.
- [catalog-fixtures.js](../../../server/tests/helpers/catalog-fixtures.js) and [fixture-repositories.js](../../../server/tests/helpers/fixture-repositories.js) build synthetic data and disposable repositories; [EditorFixtures.js](../../../src/tests/EditorFixtures.js) supplies browser catalogs. Set `SPREAD_EDITOR_DATA_DIR` to a temporary fixture data folder for server tests and use temporary repository copies. Never write real CFRU, DPE, or Unbound Cloud checkouts.

## Change checklist

1. Trace the game's Cloud file mapping, CFRU compiled values, DPE sources/macros, and image fallbacks before changing catalog fields or legality. Keep unknown values and complete diagnostic lists accurate.
2. Update targeted server fixture and endpoint assertions plus browser-visible tests for names, warnings, icons, legality, search, or loading states as appropriate. Check offline and missing-source cases.
3. Verify image URL allowlists, canonical owned-file checks, parser/cache invalidation, PNG normal/shiny rendering, and mobile-compatible fixed icon dimensions when those paths change.
4. Run the narrowest relevant commands above. Update this skill when its behavior or file ownership changes. After server code changes, remind the user to restart the API server on port 3001.
